name: Brine Flats
description: Wet salt flats washed by chemical tides, with a teal film on the surface.
role: The base ground of the Chemical Coast.

artBrief.spriteScale: Seamless square tile. Floor entities tile it over a 4×4 cell footprint.
artBrief.silhouette: Flat tile with irregular teal pools.
artBrief.detail: Salt crust ridges between shallow teal puddles with oily sheen.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Teal-green brine, pale salt, oil-black sheen.
